ian_sales: Uploaded the AURORA pen-test bundle to the secure bucket per their request. Need guidance on what we can hand over and timeline. Link: https://secure.redwood.example/aurora/2033334444 :paperclip:
audit_bot: Artifacts saved to s3://redwood-secure/aurora/2033334444/
  - report: aurora-pt-report.pdf
  - scan-xml: aurora-scan.xml.gz
  - pocs: aurora-pocs.tar.gz
  - manifest: aurora-manifest.json
  - checksums: aurora-2033334444.sha256
nora_se: quick flag 1: some PoCs include internal hostnames and one service token. Legal will not permit raw binaries or creds. We should redact PII and replace hostnames before sharing.
sylvia_eng: Agreed. I'll run the sanitizer and replace runnable PoCs with pseudo-PoC steps. Using `./tools/sanitize_artifacts.sh aurora-pocs.tar.gz > aurora-pocs-sanitized.tar.gz` ETA: today EOD (2033337200).
paul_ciso: Conditions to release to customer: (1) sanitized bundle only unless an NDA addendum is signed; (2) include CVSS, exploitability, and auth-required flags in manifest; (3) designate a Redwood security liaison for escalation. Proposed SLA: Critical=5d, High=30d, Medium=60d. If customer insists on raw PoCs require NDA + controlled access.
ian_sales: They asked for full artifacts to validate. I'll push back with our SLA and offer fast-track hotfix for criticals. Also need a one-page RA template to include.
nora_se: attaching CVSS table and exploitability notes in the manifest. Also added a scrub script reference: `tools/redact_pii.sh` (strips IPs, tokens, emails).
sylvia_eng: Sanitizer finished. Replaced hostnames with <REDACTED_HOST>, removed tokens, converted binaries to pseudo-PoC markdown. Uploaded sanitized bundle to s3://redwood-secure/aurora/2033334444/sanitized/ and updated manifest. Audit id: 2033337260.
audit_bot: Sanitary bundle published by sylvia_eng at 2033337260. Link expiry: 21 days. sha256: a9f3d7... aurora-sanitized-2033334444.sha256
sylvia_eng: Opened ticket AU-1207 to track fixes (auth-service + input validation). ETA for critical fix: 4 business days. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/AU-1207
paul_ciso: Reviewed sanitized bundle and manifest. OK to share under the conditions above. If AURORA requests raw PoC binaries without NDA, escalate to legal; do not provide.
ian_sales: Drafting email: "Attached: sanitized pen-test artifacts, manifest, CVSS + remediation timeline. Next steps: confirm acceptance of SLA and whether they require raw PoCs under NDA." Want me to send or should SE send?
nora_se: SE should send and include runbook + RA template. I'll attach the sanitized repro notes in pseudo-PoC form so they can triage safely.
ian_sales: Sounds good. I'll wait for SE to send and will cc paul_ciso and sylvia_eng. :thumbsup:
audit_bot: Notification posted to audit channel: sanitized bundle shared with sec@aurora-corp.com (pending acceptance).
